if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

#BiocManager::install("biomaRt")
#BiocManager::install("org.Mm.eg.db")
# Load required packages
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(biomaRt)
library(renv)
library(readr)
library(DESeq2)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

Import

#BiocManager::install("GenomicFeatures")
#BiocManager::install("txdbmaker")
library("GenomicFeatures")
txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF("/data_pool/raw_data/reference_genomes/mouse/ensembl/Mus_musculus.GRCm39.115.gtf")

k <- keys(txdb, keytype = "TXNAME")

tx2gene <- select(txdb, keys = k,
                  columns = c("GENEID"),
                  keytype = "TXNAME")
# Remove version numbers from transcript IDs
tx2gene[,1] <- sub("\\..*$", "", tx2gene[,1])

#write.table(tx2gene,
#            file = "tx2gene.tsv",
#            quote = FALSE,
#            sep = "\t",
#            row.names = FALSE,
#            col.names = FALSE)
#BiocManager::install("tximport")
#BiocManager::install("rhdf5")
library(tximport)
# Read your table
samples <- read.table("/projects/margeta/phagocytosis/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/samples.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

# Build named vector of kallisto abundance files
files <- setNames(samples$path, samples$sample)
#tx2gene <- read.table("tx2gene.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
# Import kallisto results
txi <- tximport(
    files,
    type = "kallisto",
    tx2gene = tx2gene,
    countsFromAbundance = "no",
    ignoreTxVersion = TRUE
)

# Build DESeq2 metadata
metadata <- samples[, c("condition", "replicate")]
rownames(metadata) <- samples$sample

# Build DESeq2 dataset
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
    txi,
    colData = metadata,
    design = ~ condition
)

DESEQ


# Run DESeq2 differential expression
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract results
res <- results(dds)

# Order by adjusted p-value
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]
res$symbol <- mapIds(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = rownames(res),
    column = "SYMBOL",
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    multiVals = "first"
)
test=as.data.frame(res)
# Save full results
#write.csv(as.data.frame(res), file = "/projects/margeta/phagocytosis/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/deseq2_results.csv")

Variance stablization (good fpr PCA/cluster/QC/distance matrices/ML that assumes homoskedastic data, not differential expression testing)

# Optional: variance stabilized data
vsd <- vst(dds)
test2=assay(vsd)
write.csv(assay(vsd), file = "normalized_vst_counts.csv")

Volcano plot

# Load packages
library(ggplot2)

# Assume 'res' is your DESeq2 results object:
# res <- results(dds)

# Convert to data frame
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)

# Add a column to indicate significance
res_df$significant <- with(
  res_df,
  ifelse(padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1, "Significant", "Not Significant")
)


# Genes to label
label_genes <- c("Trem2", "Gpmnb", "Cstb", "Spp1", "Lgals3", "Apoe")

# Add label column
res_df$label <- ifelse(res_df$symbol %in% label_genes, res_df$symbol, NA)

# Volcano plot
ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                   y = -log10(padj),
                   color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    color = "black",  
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gray", "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank()  # Removes all gridlines
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 Adjusted p-value"
  )


#BiocManager::install("EnhancedVolcano")
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# If DESeq2 results are in `res`:
# Make sure gene names are rownames
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <-  res_df %>% filter(!is.na(symbol))

# Genes to label
label_genes <- c("Csta3","Trem2", "Gpnmb", "Cstb", "Spp1", "Lgals3", "Apoe")

p<-EnhancedVolcano(
  res_df,
  lab = res_df$symbol,
  x = "log2FoldChange",
  y = "padj",
  selectLab = label_genes,     # only label these genes【2】
  labCol = "black",            # label color
  pCutoff = 0.05,
  FCcutoff = 1,
  pointSize= 0.5,
  labSize=6.0,
  colConnectors = "black",
  gridlines.major = FALSE,   # 【1】
  gridlines.minor = FALSE,
  col=c('gray', 'gray', 'gray', 'red3'),
  colAlpha = 1, 
  drawConnectors = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.75
) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2))
p

#ggsave("/projects/margeta/phagocytosis/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/251204_phag_v_no_phag_volcano.png", p, width = 10, height = 15, dpi = 300)
library(pheatmap)

# gene list
genes <- c("Csta3","Trem2","Gpnmb","Cstb","Spp1","Lgals3","Apoe","Lgals1",
           "C1qb","C1qc","Ctsd","Ctsa","Hexa","Ifi27","Ifi35","Siglecg",
           "CD74","H2-Aa")

# obtain normalized counts from the DESeq2 object
norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
rownames(norm_counts) <- mapIds(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = rownames(norm_counts),
    column = "SYMBOL",
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    multiVals = "first"
)

# subset for selected genes (keep only genes that exist)
genes_present <- genes[genes %in% rownames(norm_counts)]
mat <- norm_counts[genes_present, ]
# log-transform for visualization
mat_log <- log2(mat + 1)

# scale by row so each gene shows relative expression
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat_log)))
# color palette (blue → white → red)
colors <- colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100)

pdf("/projects/margeta/phagocytosis/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/251209_phag_wt_heatmap.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)

# plot heatmap
pheatmap(
  mat_scaled,
  color = colors,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize = 12,
  fontsize_row = 12,
  fontsize_col = 12,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Selected Gene Expression (Z‑score)",
  cellwidth = 20,
  cellheight = 15
)
dev.off()

- Lockfile written to "/projects/margeta/phagocytosis/code/renv.lock".
ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")
abundance <- read_tsv("/output/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/B6Cont1NonPhag/abundance.tsv")

tx_ids = str_remove(abundance$target_id, "\\.\\d+$")

mapping <- getBM(
    attributes = c("ensembl_transcript_id", "ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"),
    filters = "ensembl_transcript_id",
    values = tx_ids,
    mart = ensembl
)

mapping
abundance$gene_name = mapping
abundance$target_id_trimmed = tx_ids


# ---- 1. Read Kallisto abundance file ----
abundance <- read_tsv("/output/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/B6Cont1NonPhag/abundance.tsv")

# ---- 2. Read Ensembl GTF annotation ----
gtf <- read_tsv("/data/raw_data/reference_genomes/mouse/ensembl/Mus_musculus.GRCm39.115.gtf",
                comment = "#",
                col_names = FALSE)

# GTF columns (Ensembl standard):
# 1 seqname, 2 source, 3 feature, 4 start, 5 end, 6 score,
# 7 strand, 8 frame, 9 attribute

# ---- 3. Extract transcript IDs for rRNA ----
# Filter rows with rRNA biotype
rRNA_gtf <- gtf %>%
  filter(str_detect(X9, 'gene_biotype "rRNA"') | 
         str_detect(X9, 'transcript_biotype "rRNA"'))

# Extract transcript_id values
rRNA_ids <- str_match(rRNA_gtf$X9, 'transcript_id "([^"]+)"')[,2] 

# ---- 4. Filter Kallisto output for rRNA transcripts ----
rRNA_abundance <- abundance %>%
  filter(target_id_trimmed %in% rRNA_ids)

# ---- 5. Calculate total rRNA reads and total reads ----
total_rRNA_reads <- sum(rRNA_abundance$est_counts)
total_reads <- sum(abundance$est_counts)

# ---- 6. Calculate percentage ----
percent_rRNA <- (total_rRNA_reads / total_reads) * 100

# ---- 7. Output result ----
cat("Percent ribosomal reads:", round(percent_rRNA, 2), "%\n")
